subject: NimbusOS privacy follow-up — DPA request, SCC module suggestion, and data-role declaration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Patel <evan.patel@nimbusos.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NimbusOS — post-demo privacy follow-up and DPA request

Hi Evan — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (30-min call):
- You run EU-first user profiles and will be bound by GDPR for EU-resident users.
- Primary privacy asks: DPA copy, SCC options for cross-border transfers, SOC 2 status, and basic log retention/PII handling.
- You indicated legal will want a short call to confirm roles and a DPA redline.

Our position & suggested defaults:
- SOC 2: Redwood has an SOC 2 Type II in place for our inference platform (summary attached). Full report is available under NDA — we can route that to your security team.
- HIPAA: Our hosted product can be deployed with Business Associate controls for covered use cases; for now you said this is not primary.
- DPA & SCC: We maintain a standard DPA template. For SCC/module options we generally propose our "SCC Enhanced" module for customers processing EU personal data at scale — it includes the supplementary safeguards (encryption at rest, limited international subprocessors, and clear transfer mappings). We can also offer a narrower "SCC Minimal" option if you prefer less contractual overhead.
- Data role declaration (high level): Redwood recommends the classic split — NimbusOS = Controller (decides purposes/means), Redwood = Processor (provides inference service). If you have a different operating model (e.g., joint controller scenario), flag that now so we can route to legal.

Requests / proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm whether NimbusOS expects Redwood to be listed as Processor or if your legal is suggesting joint-control.
2) I'll attach our DPA template and SOC 2 summary here for your review — please loop in your legal/security and let me know preferred timing for a 30-min call.
3) If you like, fill out the attached vendor security questionnaire; we can take the first pass and return answers within 48 business hours.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_SOC2_overview.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: redwood_dpa_template.docx (DOCX)], [Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX)]

Proposed timeline: DPA redline within 2 weeks once we have a legal touchpoint (targeting sign by early Aug if both teams align).

Thanks — happy to jump on another call.

—
Marissa Cole
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Evan Patel <evan.patel@nimbusos.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Winston <ava.winston@nimbusos.com>, NimbusOS Legal <legal@nimbusos.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbusOS — post-demo privacy follow-up and DPA request

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few clarifying Qs from our side: 

1) SCC Enhanced sounds like the likely fit given EU users. Can you list (briefly) which clauses differ compared to SCC Minimal? Our legal team tends to look for: subprocessors list controls, data export carve-outs, and encryption commitments.

2) On the role split — our privacy lead prefers us to be Controller and Redwood as Processor. That said, legal will review for any joint-processing flags. Can you confirm that the DPA template explicitly states Redwood as Processor and that you don't require us to accept any processor-to-processor carve-outs that would make us co-responsible?

3) SOC 2: excellent. We will likely need the full report under NDA. Who is the right contact to request that?

4) For vendor questionnaire: would you rather we fill it out and return, or would Redwood prefer to pre-populate and send answers?

I can get our legal on a 30-min sync next week if that works — cc'd: legal@nimbusos.com and Ava (product privacy).

Evan

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbusOS — post-demo privacy follow-up and DPA request

Marissa — quick internal note before I reply to Evan.
- SCC Enhanced difference: adds mandatory subprocessors disclosure, stronger transfer language (SCCs + org-level technical controls), and an optional healthcare addendum for PHI handling. Good match for them given EU footprint.
- DPA template: our standard DPA names Redwood as Processor and includes a narrow subprocessor flow; we should avoid language that creates joint liability for customer processing choices.
- SOC 2 report: Send to security@nimbusos@placeholder? (we should route via legal@redwood — I will attach the NDA template to the reply).

Recommend we: 1) propose SCC Enhanced in the reply, 2) offer to pre-populate the vendor questionnaire to speed answers, and 3) offer 30-min legal sync Wed/Thu next week.

Karthik
Staff Privacy Counsel — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Patel <evan.patel@nimbusos.com>
Cc: NimbusOS Legal <legal@nimbusos.com>, Ava Winston <ava.winston@nimbusos.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbusOS — post-demo privacy follow-up and DPA request

Evan / Ava / NimbusOS legal — thanks for the quick replies. Couple concrete proposals so legal can triage: 

1) SCC module recommendation: SCC Enhanced (recommended). In plain terms it:
   - requires public subprocessors disclosure and a 30-day notice for new subprocessors;
   - includes additional encryption-in-transit and at-rest commitments for exported EU personal data;
   - adds a narrow transfers appendix mapping our subprocessors and transfer mechanisms.

2) DPA: we will supply the redwood_dpa_template.docx (attached). It names Redwood as Processor; it does not attempt to convert customers into joint controllers. If NimbusOS wants alternative language, please flag specific clauses for us to review.

3) SOC 2 report: happy to share under NDA. If you can send a copy of your NDA or confirm we can use a standard mutual NDA, I'll have our compliance team push the Type II to legal@redwood (cc: karthik_iyer).

4) Vendor questionnaire: we can pre-populate the attached questionnaire and return it to you within 48 hours (saves back-and-forth). If you prefer to fill, either is fine. 

Proposed next step / meeting: 30-min legal sync to run through the DPA & SCC choices. Suggested slots (PDT): Wed Jul 26 10:00–10:30, Wed Jul 26 15:00–15:30, Thu Jul 27 09:00–09:30. Pick a time and I'll calendar.

HubSpot: I linked this to deal HP-45321 for tracking.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_dpa_template.docx (DOCX)], [Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX)], [Attachment: redwood_SOC2_overview.pdf (PDF)]

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll stand by to get the NDA and calendar the meeting.

Best,
Marissa
